artworks.title: Latinus Offering his Daughter Lavinia to Aeneas in Matrimony
artworks.description: Tiepolo’s Copenhagen canvas (SMK KMS4201) places Lavinia at the hinge of Virgil’s Italian war: Latinus offers her hand to Aeneas while Latium’s future tips toward Troy. Venetian light makes the bride the quiet prize of the Aeneid’s second half — not Shakespeare’s mutilated namesake, but the Latin princess who becomes Rome’s stepmother.

films.title: The Avenger
films.description: Italian peplum retelling of Aeneas in Latium — Lavinia’s betrothal and the war with Turnus for a mid-century screen audience.

popCulture.title: Aeneid VII–XII
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Virgil’s epic makes Lavinia the destined bride for whom Turnus fights — the silent princess whose marriage founds the Latin-Trojan line.
